summary: Air Water Ventures Ltd (A1R water) filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its business combination with SPAC Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. III on August 14, 2026. The transaction, approved by SPAC shareholders on July 29, 2026, includes a fully committed $96 million PIPE anchored by Inflection Point, existing investors, Southern Glazer's Wine & Spirits, and institutions. The combined company begins trading on Nasdaq under WATR on August 17, 2026. Proceeds will scale production and retail distribution of atmospheric water. Watch for post-merger trading performance and capital deployment execution.
